text.64:6: That was because their messengers (from Allah) kept coming unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they said: Shall mere mortals guide us? So they disbelieved and turned away, and Allah was independent (of them). Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise.
text.80:5: As for him who thinketh himself independent,
text.92:8: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,
